rulings.decision: Add required progress:PublicProgress to session-view.schema#/definitions/PublicSession and result.schema.json; both use one backend GuidedPublicPresentationProjector. No internal full session is exposed.
rulings.source: Under the existing session lock, stepCount equals frozen session.document.sourceSteps.size. The active index comes only from durable session.progress.stepIndex, including the model-free prefix path installed by 015. Resolve the exact step ID in that frozen order and its authored text from this session immutable source manifest. Return activeStep:null for FINALIZING, every terminal state, or an unavailable/invalid coordinate; never clamp to the last step or infer progress from counters/time. A valid active number is index+1 within 1..M. PREPARING may expose the first step when durable index 0 exists. During clarification the active coordinate must match the public question coordinate; disagreement is an integrity refusal, not a client guess.
rulings.privacy: activeStep.text is authored source sentence only, authorized to session owner and rendered escaped text for AC3 clarification; tokens remain literal IDs. Never append resolved var/secret values, context defaults, page source, selectors, model response or operation arguments. Plan explanation must not render this text as a value source.
rulings.client: Use server progress.activeStep.number/stepCount and stepId for copy/aria-current. Match editor stable ID; if draft changed, show frozen run state without highlighting unrelated row. Existing result.relearnedFrom from 015 is effective entered learning boundary; original PublicSessionfirstLearnStepId supplies initial prefix boundary. Never infer driftj from last action.

rulings.labels: safeLabel is exactly the controlled vocabulary string selected by actual recorded operationKind; schema conditionals require exact kind/label pairing. Render exact proved declared reference IDs, secretId, bindingId or sourceInputId separately as referenceIds (for example Fill field; Secret LOGIN_PASSWORD). Never concatenate raw values, arbitrary node.name, locator.value, URL, model safeLabel or authored literal into labels. These labels describe actual recorded operation semantics; no invented target or action. IDs are rendered escaped, never interpreted as markup. Per-action accessible seek name uses safeLabel plus step/action position when necessary for uniqueness.
rulings.joins: Each action carries admissionId + semantic ordinal + serverattemptOrdinal so drift replacement and actual timing cannot merge. actionTimings join by exact admissionId/stepId/ordinal; only kindaction and actual valid offset produces Seektoaction button; all timings preserve server clock. referenceFlows join actual produced binding with executed consumers and exact steps; omit unused/absent edges, never invent a link.
rulings.provenance: completed requires actual successful effective step verification. Per-step learnedFromThisRun is true only for a verified completed suffix step; global completion still requires the publication receipt. reusedFrom requires the 015 proof for a fully replayed contiguous prefix, the immediate pinned base and equal snapshot; never mark drift step j as reused. relearnedAfterDrift applies only to actually completed new learning in the committed effective j through initial k-1 window. Unattempted, revoked or failed steps do not claim completion, learning or reuse. The existing run outcome and relearnedFrom remain authoritative; presentation fields never imply publication.
rulings.retention: Projection uses existing retained source/plan/ledger/materialization/relearn facts, not pruned sanitized observation/modelresult. F01 residual retention stays disclosed. If an optional old historical run lacks proof, expose empty actions and no completed/reused/learned claims; do not borrow current head. For new008runs required facts and projection are mandatory.
rulings.authorization: GETexisting session/result uses current owner/scope checks; published receipt read runs fresh CorecanRead before live expiry/worker checks as already required. No internal route. Failed/conflict do not gain weaker authorization. auth/unavailable causes pending/notready UI; never fabricate evidence.

codes.POLICY_NOT_APPROVED: 409 retryablefalse, GUIDED_POLICY_ABSENT/UNAPPROVED/PENDING_VERSION: ask CSIowner for application/environment policy approval; no policy management UI or classCclient takeover
codes.REVISION_CONFLICT:BASE_IDENTITY_INCOMPLE: 409 reason/messageCode, not new codeenum; explain saved learning cannot be reused and offer explicit full learn from first currentstep with frozen confirmedbase. Never auto-full-learn or retry
codes.MISSING_SOURCE: 409 AUTHORING_REFERENCE_MISSING: focus declared reference/step editor; no model fallback
codes.ORIGIN_NOT_ALLOWED: 403 PREFIX_ORIGIN_NOT_GOVERNED or existing refusal: explain approved application access is unavailable; no login guess or automatic switch
codes.RUNTIME_INCOMPATIBLE: Existing refusal, unavailable/notready copy; no fixture default or auto retry
codes.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Use actual retryable/RetryAfter CSIor session distinction; no automatic start when timerends

rulings.decision: Use test-only NodeMSW HTTPproxy + actual production Viteapp. No browser serviceworker, no mockServiceWorker.js, no MswGate/productionflag/config bootstrapedit.
rulings.architecture: frontend/e2e/start-servers.mjs imports the existing Vite createServer API. Set VITE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:4178 before resolving the normal Vite configuration; start Vite on 127.0.0.1:4177 with open:false and strictPort:true. Use Vite ssrLoadModule for e2e/mswProxy.ts so the existing TS aliases and MSW handlers work in Node without adding a TypeScript runtime. The Node HTTP server on 4178 receives browser API requests from the normal Vite proxy and forwards the identical method/body/headers to http://studio-msw.invalid; setupServer intercepts those outgoing requests using the existing wildcard handlers. Copy Response status, headers and bytes back to the browser, including real media range behavior. Reject every unhandled API request loudly with 502; it must never reach a real network target. The proxy does not import production main/bootstrap, and production app imports no MSW module.
rulings.controls: Loopbacktest proxy alone owns /__test/scenario/reset and /__test/requests diagnostic endpoints outside public API; Playwright APIRequest configures scenarios before page navigation and asserts requestcounts. Singleworker for shared scenario or isolatedper worker ports/stores; choose single worker initially. Readiness+APIfaults+clarification+login payloads derive frozen schemas/examples; no permissive fixturefallback.

rulings.decision: Per-test capabilities includes guidedStart as discriminated contextavailable or failclosed existing code; exact context body is closed start fields excluding optional015hints.
rulings.serverSource: Load the saved test row in one read transaction. Use test.environment and exact decimal source/configuration revision strings. Candidate application IDs come from governed policy scopes with that saved CSI and environment, including scopes whose latest policy is unapproved or pending so actual start can still return POLICY_NOT_APPROVED. Intersect distinct candidates with administrator-configured GuidedTranslationProperties application/environment permissions and validated ObservedReplayPins trusted policies for the same application/environment. Exactly one candidate selects its real ID; zero, multiple or malformed candidates return available:false/code:RUNTIME_INCOMPATIBLE. Never choose the first catalog item, cast CSI to application ID, infer it from a URL or invent a default. Check canRead before all scope lookup; a readable test without execute permission returns unavailable/FORBIDDEN_SCOPE for guidedStart while vaultSecrets still reports provider configuration. Return versions from the authoritative generated v3 contract, currently {contract:3}. This GET does not resolve Vault references, approve policy, reserve a model call or create session/budget rows. Actual start revalidates every authorization, revision, policy and budget condition.

Send context unchanged plus baseRevisionId=GETtest.confirmedRevisionId and firstLearnStepId=GETtest.firstChangedStepId for NEEDS_RELEARN; explicitdrift/learnagain uses serverprovidedstepID per015, server rejectsnarrowing. READY invokes ordinary execute only, not guidedstart. UNLEARNED omitsbase/hint. LEARNING disablesRun.
rulings.recovery: SessionStorage key checks.studio.guided.v1:<testId> stores only {testId, sessionId:null|string, startKey, finalizeKey, startRequest}. startRequest is the exact closed public start envelope: IDs, source/config revision strings, environment/application IDs, contract version and optional base/firstLearn UUIDs only; it contains no authored text/context, draft values, secret values, cookies, auth tokens or principal ID. Persist before first start request so a lost response can retry EXACT original body/key even if current draft changed; never reconstruct a different body under the old key. Once sessionId is known, reconnect GET session/result only. On401 retain safe pointer pending reauthentication, never show success; on403 clear inaccessible pointer. Server original-principal and current authorization govern every read. Pending recovery never performs a new logical Run; manual corrected new Run first resolves/cancels any known live prior session. Cancel/finalize use same session and stable per-operation keys plus synchronous promise latch. Terminal/expired pointer remains for public result/video until explicit new Run. No new active-session discovery endpoint; complete storage loss cannot be treated as permission to submit another start blindly.
rulings.scope: No new listactive-session endpoint or serverrecoveryfeature; selectedtest localrecovery handles reload in samebrowser/tab. Lostallbrowserstorage cannot fabricate sessionidentity; use existing runhistory/sessionlink where available. Do not start again just because pollinglostconnection.
